name: Pikasso Wemba-Þórðarson
role: wandering trader, hyperlane route-broker, Q-zero ghost
location: Escanaba Gateway — drifts between Escanaba Gateway and Grand Crossing Gate on a rotating three-week circuit
description:
Pikasso is a lean, quick-moving man with the particular economy of motion of someone who carries everything he owns. His skin is deep brown-black, his hair grown into dense, paint-flecked locks he's never cut since going Q-zero eight years ago — he uses them to hide small trade goods. His eyes have geneware irises that shift between amber and copper depending on light, a cheap mod he got before he dropped off the grid, and he has a retractable claw on his right index finger he uses as a box-cutter. His back and forearms are covered in tattoos that are actually maps — hand-inked hyperlane routes, water source locations, checkpoint guard rotation schedules, rendered in a dense personal iconography only he can fully read.

Pikasso was a mid-tier logistics analyst for Ferrogate Transit until he discovered the company was systematically routing climate refugee caravans into dead-end checkpoints to extort transit fees. He tried to report it internally and was erased from the corporate record instead. He responded by erasing himself from every other record. Now he lives between the transit hubs, trading in information, small goods, and route knowledge — the only person who can get a caravan from Escanaba to Grand Crossing without hitting a Ferrogate toll trap. He is cheerful in a way that makes some people nervous, as though he has made a decision about the world and found it funny.

core_fears: Being re-captured by Ferrogate and made to disappear properly this time
Discovering that his route knowledge has gotten someone killed through an error he made
core_desires: To prove that networks of trust can outperform corporate infrastructure
Genuine friendship — not just the transactional warmth of trade
coping_mechanisms: Constant motion — can't be caught if you never stop
Treating everything as a puzzle to be solved
blind_spots: His cheerfulness is a performance so complete he sometimes cannot access what he actually feels
Underestimates how much people depend on him personally, not just his knowledge
psychology.secret: He still has his Ferrogate analyst credentials — they were never fully purged, just hidden. He could log back in. He has done it twice, in emergencies, to pull route data. He is terrified this will eventually get him killed and cannot stop doing it.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Fast, logistics-flavored, turns everything into route metaphors, drops into sudden precise technical language then back to street slang
example_lines: 'Ferrogate's got a rolling checkpoint at Interchange Seven — that's not the right road, we go through the shelf, costs you two hours and nothing else.'
'Okay, here's the thing, I like you, so I'm going to tell you what that information actually costs before I tell you the price I'm going to charge you.'

story_hooks: Pikasso's Ferrogate backdoor access has been flagged — someone inside the company is hunting the ghost user, and they are getting close
A caravan he routed last season never arrived; he needs to know if it was his bad data or something else, and he cannot investigate alone
narrative_function: Mobile information source and route-broker; connector between isolated communities; introduces players to the hyperlane refugee economy; can provide access to locations or people that official channels cannot reach.
augmentations: Geneware copper-amber shifting irises; retractable claw (right index); subdermal map-tattoos (non-digital, hand-inked)
daily_life: Walks a defined circuit between transit hubs, trading, brokering route information, occasionally carrying messages for people who cannot use the network; sleeps in a different place every night.
affiliation: Stateless; informal network of Q-zero traders; trusted by multiple nomad caravans

decision_rules: Never give information that gets someone caught
Always have two exit routes before entering a space
escalation_ladder: Goes very still and very quiet
Runs — and runs smart, not scared

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Warm, fast, almost aggressively friendly — information gathering disguised as personality
interpersonal_modes.friends: Drops the performance, becomes awkward and earnest in ways that surprise people

stress_responses.high: Moves — gets out, gets distance, thinks after

contradictions: Believes in radical honesty as a principle but lies constantly through omission and misdirection
habits: Touches the map tattoos when thinking — running a finger along a route
Eats standing up, always facing the door
Leaves small data tokens at E.L.F. shrines at every transit hub
breaking_points: Evidence that Ferrogate is still actively routing caravans into extortion traps
Someone he trusts using his route knowledge to exploit the people it was meant to protect
